layers.name: Page
layers.purpose: Paste a query and a suggestion
layers.detail: One server route proxies the optional AI call. Nothing else leaves the browser.

layers.name: Guard
layers.purpose: One read-only SELECT; model output is untrusted
layers.detail: Pasted SQL and model output pass the same check.

layers.name: Worker + PostgreSQL
layers.detail: PostgreSQL compiled to WebAssembly runs in a worker. Index trials are always rolled back.

layers.name: Verdict rule
layers.detail: A multiset comparison of results, then timing with a 1.5× threshold confirmed by cost or rows read.

boundary.rule: Privacy boundary: images and embeddings never cross

layers.name: Clients
layers.purpose: Web app, kiosk QR, camera worker
layers.detail: Three ways to check in, each able to fail silently.

layers.name: Worker on the device
layers.purpose: Recognition runs locally; requests are signed
layers.detail: Face matching happens on the device. Only signed attendance events leave it.

layers.name: API
layers.purpose: 64 routes; session cookie and CSRF; route matrix
layers.detail: Every route is listed in a generated authorisation matrix.

layers.name: Presence engine
layers.detail: Every millisecond of a session gets exactly one state.

layers.name: PostgreSQL
layers.detail: Idempotency keys and row locks taken in a fixed order.

layers.name: Parse
layers.detail: Source files parsed with Python's ast module.

layers.name: Graph
layers.detail: A dependency graph built with networkx.

layers.name: Retrieve
layers.detail: Neighbours are added, then reranked; centrality questions get an in-degree bonus.

title: Research data platform in five layers

layers.name: Raw
layers.purpose: Immutable; one version per name and SHA-256
layers.detail: A file already seen is never stored twice.

layers.name: Quality gates
layers.purpose: Fail the load before core is written
layers.detail: Bad input stops the run instead of reaching analysis.

layers.name: Core
layers.detail: Three provenance classes kept apart by key and constraint.

layers.name: Reconciliation
layers.detail: The load is not finished until these pass.
